predecessors.text: the seven islands: Corfu, Paxoi, Lefkada, Cephalonia, Ithaca, Zakynthos and Kythira

ledger.x: 2 April 1800: the Septinsular Republic is established.
20 August 1807: the islands are ceded to France.

wars.name: Russo-Ottoman capture of the Ionian Islands
wars.outcome: A joint Russo-Ottoman fleet under Admiral Fyodor Ushakov drove the French out of the other islands in autumn 1798 and 'finally captured Corfu on 4 March [O.S.

certainty.note: Island coasts are sharp by nature; the mainland exclaves (Parga, Vonitsa, Preveza, Butrinto) are not drawn, and the page leaves their status unclear.
